topics.summary: reflection: Explicit implementation cases and provider evidence
usages: penpair reflection check --map FILE --engine-config FILE --engine-version VERSION [--release-context FILE]
instructions: Requires this adapter in the project configuration. Read the relevant package guide before applying writes. Inspection and captured files do not constitute owner approval.

Native mode loads the trusted project createReflectionConfig(request) export and the project-installed exact engine version. Requires managed immutable reference copies and independently measured capture hooks. Missing proof is incomplete, never approved. Release context binds exact full design inventory; implementation acceptance stays separate.
